canny_input: original float32 grayscale glyph [0,1]; no binarization
projection: same ideal L1 Gaussian kernels as skeleton; float32 dot product
selection: rank all 256 scores descending, ties index ascending, take exactly 64; zero-score fill by index; never use target geometry
renderer: original frozen renderer; unit amplitudes; L1 kernels; no global clipping or normalization
classifier: class means, mean across ideal plus four training mappings for MMA, then L2 normalize and cosine; ideal-only uses ideal only

statistics.unit: character cluster; all six fonts and five mappings retained together
statistics.CI: percentile 95%, conditional on fixed fonts/maps; unadjusted exploratory

tuning: none; one fixed Canny setting; retain every cell regardless of result
future_test: no final unseen test pool accessed or claimed
